messages:
harper: FYI route `embed-api` spiked and sampler dropped most captures. We need a safer short-term visibility mechanism.
vik: saw alert. Idea: a PII-exposure "ledger" per route that counts tokens allowed to be exposed, not just raw samples.
mira: +1. Ledger fields: remaining_tokens, recharge_rate, max_burst_minutes. Console can show remaining and a spend button.
audit-bot: ALERT: route=embed-api sample_drop_rate=0.93 at 2026-05-02T14:02:10Z
vik: enforcement: spend requests must include actor, reason, ticket and write immutable audit event. No silent increases.
harper: UX: "Preview spend" should compute estimated_exposed_tokens = sample_frac * tokens_likely_pii and show redaction_confidence histogram. If confidence <0.7 hide raw payloads.
zen: telemetry: add fields exposure_delta_estimate, redaction_confidence, before_tokens, after_tokens. Alert if delta_estimate > 2000 -> require 2FA.
ui: console mock: compact panel with ring showing ledger %, preview delta, actions: "Spend 5m", "Isolate route", "Request reserved capacity". Each action shows required approvers.
mira: API shape draft: POST /internal/routes/{route}/ledger/spend {minutes, profile, reason, ticket}. Response must return before/after ledger values and exposure_delta_estimate.
vik: rollout: ops-only flag, canary 3 tenants, metric to watch: redaction_fail_rate (should not increase by >1.5x).
harper: CLI snippet for ops: `ri ops ledger-spend --route=embed-api --minutes=10 --profile=diag --ticket=INC-9999 --reason="debug"` emits audit entry.
audit-bot: AUDIT: actor=harper action=ledger_spend route=embed-api minutes=10 before=4123 after=3523 ticket=INC-9999 ts=2026-05-02T14:05:00Z
vik: owners: mira->API + enforcement, zen->telemetry, ui->console mock, harper->rollout. Follow-up sync tomorrow 9:30."
